Gene Set Variation Analysis (GSVA)

rna_gsva.Rd

Computes pathway activity scores for individual samples using GSVA-based methods. Gene sets can be obtained directly from a previous rna_gsea() analysis, MSigDB collections, or user-supplied pathways.

Unlike GSEA, which evaluates pathway enrichment between groups, GSVA estimates pathway activity for each sample individually.

Usage

rna_gsva(
  project,
  source = c("gsea", "msigdb", "custom"),
  pathways = NULL,
  pathway_scope = c("top", "significant", "all"),
  geneset_collection = "H",
  geneset_subcollection = NULL,
  method = c("gsva", "ssgsea", "zscore", "plage"),
  kcdf = "Gaussian",
  min_size = 10,
  max_size = 500,
  save = TRUE
)

Arguments

project

rna_project object.

source

Character. Source of gene sets: gsea, msigdb or custom.

pathways

Optional named list of gene sets when source = 'custom'.

pathway_scope

Character. Determines search scope between: top, significant, or all

geneset_collection

MSigDB collection when source = "msigdb".

geneset_subcollection

MSigDB subcollection.

method

GSVA method: gsva, ssgsea, zscore or plage.

kcdf

Kernel used by GSVA.

min_size

Minimum pathway size.

max_size

Maximum pathway size.

save

Logical. Save result into project.

gsea

Optional gsea_result object when source = 'gsea'.

Value

Object of class gsva_result.
